title: Calculate O₂ partial pressure in He from Ta/Ta₂O₅ equilibrium
action: Using standard thermodynamic data for Ta(s) and Ta₂O₅(s), compute the equilibrium oxygen partial pressure (log P_O₂) in the He atmosphere at 1650, 1700, 1750, and 1800°C based on the reaction 2Ta(s) + (5/2)O₂(g) ⇌ Ta₂O₅(s).
description: Intermediate calculation required for downstream equilibrium partial pressure computation in He. Writes temperature and log P_O₂ values.
output_schema: Text log containing lines with temperature (in °C) and log₁₀(P_O₂ in atm).

title: Calculate ΔG° and log K for mullite decomposition and SiO oxidation
action: Using standard thermodynamic data for 3Al₂O₃·2SiO₂(s), Al₂O₃(s), SiO(g), O₂(g), and SiO₂(g), compute standard Gibbs free energy changes (ΔG° in kcal/mol) and log₁₀(K) for reaction (2): 3Al₂O₃·2SiO₂(s) ⇌ 3Al₂O₃(s) + 2SiO(g) + O₂(g) and reaction (3): 2SiO(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SiO₂(g) at 1650, 1700, 1750, and 1800°C.
description: Intermediate calculation providing ΔG° and log K values needed for the final equilibrium pressure computation.
output_schema: Text log with lines for each reaction and temperature, containing ΔG° (kcal/mol) and log₁₀(K).

title: Compute equilibrium partial pressures and compile final results
action: Using the equilibrium constants from step_01 and the P_O₂ values from step_00 (for He) along with the known P_O₂ in air (10⁻⁰·⁶⁸ atm ≈ 0.21 atm), compute the equilibrium partial pressures of SiO and SiO₂ in air and in He at 1650°C. Write a JSON file containing all computed quantities: reaction (2) ΔG° and log K, reaction (3) ΔG° and log K, and equilibrium_partial_pressures_at_1650C with values for air and He.
description: The scoped reproduction target. Contains all reproduced thermodynamic values.
output_schema: JSON object with top-level keys: reaction_2, reaction_3, equilibrium_partial_pressures_at_1650C. reaction_2 and reaction_3 each contain: temperatures_C (list of ints), delta_G_kcal_per_mol (list of floats), log_K (list of floats). equilibrium_partial_pressures_at_1650C contains: air and He, each containing P_SiO_atm (float) and P_SiO2_atm (float).
